entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""As I said earlier, we've been work..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said earlier, we've been working on this bill for a long time, Mr. President. I've always done my best to represent my people... only to keep getting blocked in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How can I help you, Mr. Leke?""
entries.dialogueText: "How can I help you, Mr. Leke?"
entries.menuText: "How can I help you, Mr. Leke?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""But all that we get is disrespect...."
entries.dialogueText: "But all that we get is disrespect. MPs shouting racial slurs at us, not allowing us to speak. And it's not only the National Front..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Now I can speak freely without Mrs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I can speak freely without Mrs. Tory leading the floor, but the outcome is no different."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I've always brought my people's co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've always brought my people's concerns to the Assembly and raised my voice whenever our rights were in question. All we ask is that the Assembly at least have a proper discussion."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The Assembly does not take us inde..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly does not take us independents seriously."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I don't even remember a time when..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't even remember a time when Mrs. Tory allowed me to finish a speech."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""We need your help.""
entries.dialogueText: "We need your help."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand you, Mr. Leke. This d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand you, Mr. Leke. This discrimination against you is unacceptable."
entries.menuText: "I understand you, Mr. Leke. This discrimination against you is unacceptable."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't see what I can do. This is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see what I can do. This is the cold truth of Sordish politics."
entries.menuText: "I don't see what I can do. This is the cold truth of Sordish politics."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""We can't have the same happen agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't have the same happen again."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""That's where your help would be ve..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's where your help would be very valuable."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I don't think you are taking this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think you are taking this issue seriously, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""If you wanted to help, you could d..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you wanted to help, you could do that very easily. You cannot let this vicious cycle run its course. The USP's Bludish voters have high expectations of you."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""All we need is your support for ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "All we need is your support for our bill."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured at the papers that I ha..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured at the papers that I had received from him earlier.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""It's time to undo the mistakes of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's time to undo the mistakes of the Sordish state against its citizens. I only ask you to help us make this single step for good instead of staying idle."

entries.dialogueText: "I came here today to show you our gratitude and thank you again personally."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""According to the movement, there i..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the movement, there is still one more thing to do. We'd appreciate your help on it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How can I help you, Mr. Leke?""
entries.dialogueText: "How can I help you, Mr. Leke?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course. Just tell me what you n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. Just tell me what you need."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not sure if I can do more afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure if I can do more after all I've done for your people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you still have demands? Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you still have demands? Really?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I understand where you're coming f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand where you're coming from, Mr. President, but please hear us out."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""We just want you to undo the mista..."
entries.dialogueText: "We just want you to undo the mistakes of the Sordish state against Bludish political movements."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""After all you've done, is this rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all you've done, is this really such a major thing for you or the nationalists?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""This is very disappointing. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is very disappointing. But I understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped for a moment and reposit..."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped for a moment and repositioned himself on his seat.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And considering now that I'm repre..."
entries.dialogueText: "And considering now that I'm representing the Workers Party in the Assembly as its new leader..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""...I have a lot more responsibilit..."
entries.dialogueText: "...I have a lot more responsibility against my people."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The Assembly does not take the Wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly does not take the Workers Party seriously."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Are you aware of the actions of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you aware of the actions of the Minister of Interior? How she's making life difficult for some locals? What her police is doing to our community leaders?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The situation might be better now..."
entries.dialogueText: "The situation might be better now with the autonomous zone but the history of our people and their memories will remain."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""It will revoke the current ban and..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will revoke the current ban and allow both the Worker's Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party into politics once more."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Needless to say, your decree must..."
entries.dialogueText: "Needless to say, your decree must also revoke the current ban and allow both the Worker's Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party into politics once more."
